title: CyberCam
summary: Transform your Cardputer Zero into a retro camera with 8MP, GIFs & timelapse!
description: CyberCam is an open-source camera app for Cardputer Zero by Cybern0mads. It supports 8MP photo capture, animated GIFs, MP4 video, timelapse with automatic MP4 export, stop-motion capture, boomerang clips, Wi-Fi gallery and downloads, and multiple retro / cyberpunk visual filters. It is designed for handheld use with a simple keyboard-driven interface and a visible on-device gallery.
